Highlights
Frank Bisignano donates to Trump Accounts for children in Brooklyn, NY
Oct. 29, 2026 – Today, Frank J. Bisignano, a native of Brooklyn’s Old Mill Basin neighborhood, announced a donation from The Bisignano Family Fund to the Trump Accounts of children living in his hometown zip code.
IRS launches new mobile app, expanding digital services for taxpayers
IR-2026-114, Sept. 25, 2026 — The IRS today announced the launch of the new IRS mobile app, replacing IRS2Go and expanding the agency’s digital services to give taxpayers more ways to securely access IRS tools and account services from their mobile devices.
Latest news releases
IRS issues frequently asked questions about the Low-income Communities Bonus Credit Amount Program
IR-2026-139, Nov. 13, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service today issued frequently asked questions in Fact Sheet 2026-15 about the Low-income Communities Bonus Credit Amount Program.
IRS appoints 10 new members to Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee
IR-2026-138, Nov. 13, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service today announced the appointment of 10 new members to the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee (ETAAC).

IRS shares Agency Financial Report for fiscal year 2026
IR-2026-137, Nov. 12, 2026 — The IRS today announced the publication of its Agency Financial Report for Fiscal Year 2026, detailing the IRS’s sound financial position and its commitment to accountability and transparency to the American people.
401(k) limit increases to $25,500 for 2027, IRA limit remains $7,500
IR-2026-136, Nov. 12, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service announced today that the amount individuals can contribute to their 401(k) plans in 2027 has increased to $25,500, up from $24,500 for 2026.

IRS reminder: Permanent charitable contribution deduction begins for returns filed next year for taxpayers who do not itemize
IR-2026-135, Nov. 10, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service today reminded individual taxpayers who do not itemize deductions that the Working Families Tax Cuts provides a permanent deduction for charitable contributions made in 2026.
IRS expands Tax Pro Account for business client payments
IR-2026-134, Nov. 6, 2026 — The IRS today announced that authorized tax professionals can now make certain payments on behalf of their business clients through Tax Pro Account.

IRS releases tax inflation adjustments for tax year 2027; taxpayers continue to benefit from the Working Families Tax Cuts
IR-2026-133, Nov. 5, 2026 — The Internal Revenue Service today announced the tax year 2027 annual inflation adjustments for almost 70 tax provisions, including the tax rate schedules, standard deduction amounts and other tax changes. Revenue Procedure 2026-35 provides details about these annual adjustments.
Treasury, IRS announce Opportunity Zones designations for over 6,500 communities across America
IR-2026-132, Nov. 5, 2026 — The U.S. Department of the Treasury and the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) today announced the Qualified Opportunity Zone (QOZ) designations for all 50 states, territories, and the District of Columbia.
